name: Mister Negative
summary: Martin Li leads a charity in public and a criminal inner circle as Mister Negative. He is a Spider-Man villain from the Brand New Day era. The Insomniac games use their own version of him on Earth-1048.
relation: Spider-Man villain, with a separate game version.
powers: A corrupting touch that reverses a person’s inner nature, plus control of a criminal crew.
origin: Li’s philanthropic life splits from a dark persona born out of an experimental accident.
